columns.name: id
columns.description: Surrogate primary key, generated on every insert.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier. NOT NULL per PI2; participates in composite unique key PI1.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location identifier. NOT NULL per PI2; participates in composite unique key PI1.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Current stock level. NOT NULL per PI2; bounded below by CHECK (quantity >= 0) per PI3.

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Inventory classification code. NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Identity of the user or system that filed this record. Set on creation, immutable thereafter (enforced at the service layer). Supports NFR-F1-1 audit trail.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Wall-clock time of the first file operation. Immutable after creation (service layer). Supports NFR-F1-1 unmodifiable timestamp.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent upsert. Refreshed by the repository on every write; reflects PI4 upsert activity.

schema_changes.detail: Create table stock_records with columns: id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() (PK), sku TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, inventory_code TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); unique constraint UNIQUE (sku, location); CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Purely additive creation. The downgrade() function executes DROP TABLE stock_records making the migration fully reversible (PI5). No pre-existing rows are touched on first deploy. The unique constraint on (sku, location) is created inline so the index is authoritative from the first migration revision.
